 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.179/2022 dated 14.04.2022 registered at Police Station-Jaisingh Nagar, District-Shahdol (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 42, 366,
376, 376(2)
(n) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
Applicant is in detention since 18.04.2022.

A s per the prosecution story, on 14.04.2022, prosecutrix's father lodged an F.I.R. alleging that her 17 years & 3 months old daughter is missing since 11.04.2022 and despite search, she could not be traced.
F.I.R. was registered.
Almost after 8 days of missing, prosecutrix appeared before the police.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 18.04.2022.
He has not committed any office.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that applicant is a young boy of 21 years of age.
At the time of alleged offence, prosecutrix was above 17 years of age.
In this case, prosecutrix and other witnesses have already been examined.
Now, there is no possibility of tampering with the prosecution evidence.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant, who is in jail for more than 16 months, may be released on bail pending the trial.
4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that prosecutrix and other witnesses have already been examined before the trial Court and now, there is no possibility of tampering with the prosecution evidence, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicant - Krishnapal Singh Gond @ Kishan Singh Gond be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

entities.text: Krishnapal Singh Gond @ Kishan Singh Gond
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Krishnapal Singh Gond @ Kishan Singh ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48172941/
